simulator_assumptions: simulator=nautilus-SimulatedExchange equivalent-of-SandboxExecutionClient core (matching/fills/fees all nautilus; no bot fill engine)
modeled delays: submit_delay_ms=50 (pre-queue; submit_immediate bypasses, exits-only) + fill_delay_ms=50 (venue latency, >0 enforced); submit_immediate bypasses both for one command
fees: taker=5.0bps maker=5.0bps off-instrument (MakerTakerFeeModel; run-mode fees never zero; maker unused under taker-only)

liquidity=taker-only: MARKET/STOP_MARKET/TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET cross the book; canonical LIMIT maps to nautilus LIMIT IOC (marketable-or-cancel, keeps price protection); resting GTC limits unsupported (no queue model); non-taker fills fail closed

markets are GTC (never IOC-cancelled for thin prints): with quotes they resolve on the next tick; on trade-only replay prints seed L1 size, the print size fills at-print and swept excess walks one tick adverse (nautilus empty-book model); queued submits that outlive expire_at_utc expire unsubmitted (queued-past-window)

valuation-only marks (B2): note_mark records the reference mark for accounting only — it can NEVER produce a fill; all fills cross real bid/ask + liquidity from the quote/trade/depth feed (feed/note_event); submit_protected limit entries cancel when the touch cannot be lifted

time model: engine clock advances on fed data/receipts only; poll/advance never invent market ticks; strict_replay=True fails closed on out-of-order replay input instead of restamping (live default stays receipt-lenient)
deterministic ids (B1): client ids derive from random_seed's RNG stream (stable across same-seed runs); trade ids are venue FNV-1a; restart replays the RNG stream past journaled ids

funding (B2): markPrice terms feed boundary settlements from open cache positions as pure rate x notional (no venue settlement tax exists or is applied); only venue-asserted boundaries settle (no self-projection past the last record); absent/unknown terms invalidate (settle nothing, never zero); unpriced/flat/zero-rate settlements book nothing
margins (B2): account_margin reads the simulated MarginAccount filed through nautilus' own portfolio path (update_order/update_account on each fill); leverage is engine-owned (matches the risk cap)
bounds (B10): max_queued_submits/max_pending_events fail closed with OverflowError so bursts surface instead of growing unbounded
instruments auto-register from live venue filters (PRICE_FILTER/LOT_SIZE/MIN_NOTIONAL) on first sight; qty floored to step, prices rounded to tick, REST failure fails closed (filters never invented)

reduce-only honored by the venue (use_reduce_only=True) against ExecutionEngine-equivalent netting positions filed from simulator fills; stop/target legs are independent orders (support_contingent_orders=False; no OCO assumption)
stops/targets reject when the trigger is already in the market (reject_stop_orders=True); attach_protection legs verify via poll, never assumed

fills propagate to the bound outcome sink exactly-once-accounted (journaled delta-propagated; at-least-once replay on bind/recover, sink dedups); forecast costs and booked fill costs are never double-charged
restart: sim orders never survive; recover() rebuilds tracking from the journal, replays unpropagated fills, marks the rest lost-on-restart (never assumed filled/cancelled/flat)
paper mode instantiates no Binance live execution client (R0, tested)

receipt-time processing: ticks older than the engine clock (mark-quote skew, cross-symbol interleave) are re-stamped to engine-now with ts_event preserved; the book updates, time stays monotonic; ordered replay passes through untouched
